metadata.scope: Unify ailang test --package discovery across *_test.ail files and inline-bearing ordinary modules while retaining RunTestsFromFileWithConfig as the execution and seed-identity seam.
metadata.non_scope: No AILANG syntax or runtime changes; no internal/testing behavior changes; no directory-mode discovery change; no AST cache optimization.
metadata.execution_environment: Work on the current coordinator branch. Preserve unrelated work. Use temporary package fixtures and the built ailang binary for command-level exit/output assertions.
metadata.gate_commands: go test ./cmd/ailang -run 'TestPackageTestDiscovery|TestPackageAndFileAggregates'; go test ./cmd/ailang/...; make fmt; make lint; make test

velocity.basis: Bottom-up estimate: about 70 production LOC, 210 test/fixture LOC, and 50 help/changelog or adjustment LOC. Seven-day git history contains only the v0.42.0 release commit, so the approved design's two-day estimate is the more reliable baseline.

features.description: Add built-binary package fixtures that pin inline-only, mixed, empty, parse-error, deterministic-order, and seed-parity behavior before changing discovery.
acceptance_criteria: Inline-only package regression test fails on the v0.42.0 baseline because package mode executes zero tests.
Mixed package JSON asserts dedicated and inline test results occur exactly once in lexical walk order.
Empty union exits 0 with a warning naming both dedicated files and inline blocks.
Invalid ordinary module exits 1 and reports a synthetic parse failure.
The same inline property under --seed 42 reports the same seed in package and direct-file modes.

features.description: Admit dedicated files, inline-bearing ordinary modules, and parse-invalid modules into one walk-ordered run list; execute only through runTestFile; share result merging between package and directory modes.
acceptance_criteria: Package mode executes the union in filepath.Walk order without convention-based phases.
Discovery-time collection never replaces RunTestsFromFileWithConfig execution or seed derivation.
Parse-invalid ordinary modules cannot be filtered into a false-green empty suite.
One merge helper covers tests, properties, counters, vacuous skips, and duration in both command modes.
Focused package discovery, aggregate seed, JSON purity, replay, and allow-skips tests pass.

features.description: Publish the widened package-test contract in CLI help and the changelog, then run focused and repository validation gates.
acceptance_criteria: ailang test --help describes dedicated and inline package discovery via ailang.toml.
CHANGELOG.md names the intentional behavior change and issue #959.
make fmt, make lint, and make test pass, with any unrelated inherited failure recorded verbatim.
